title: Vacuum gripper and method for monitoring the functionality of a vacuum gripper

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper but does not specify it as cordless, handheld, or battery-powered. It mentions connection to a vacuum source.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 0002) The reference explicitly mentions a sealing lip that forms a sealed region against the workpiece.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum source but does not specify an electric vacuum pump mounted within a rigid body. It refers to a 'Unterdruckquelle' (vacuum source) generally.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a sensor element that outputs a signal dependent on the vacuum level in the suction chamber.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 0055) The reference discloses alarm thresholds for performance loss, which implies a warning, but does not explicitly state that this threshold is above a 'release vacuum level' or that it is an early warning before complete release.
features.quote_src: Anschließend werden anhand der im Lernmodus aufgenommenen Ansprechsignale entsprechende Alarmschwellen festgelegt. Diese Alarmschwellen werden vorzugsweise so gewählt, dass frühzeitig der Betreiber des Sauggreifers 100 über einen Performanceverlust des Sauggreifers 100 informiert wird.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 0013) The reference discusses comparing actual vacuum to a target value to detect wear, which is related to performance, but does not explicitly define a warning threshold relative to a load-release vacuum level.
features.quote_src: Wenn beispielsweise erfasst wird, dass der Ist-Wert des in dem Saugraum anliegenden Unterdruckes bei einem vorab festgelegten oder festlegbaren Wert eines zur Betätigung des Sauggreifers an dem Sauggreifer angelegten Vakuums einen bestimmten Soll-Wert unterschreitet, ist auf einen Verschleiß von Komponenten

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference mentions issuing error messages or warnings but does not specify if the warning indicator remains active continuously while the vacuum is below a threshold.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference does not mention a rechargeable battery or any specific power source for the vacuum gripper, only a 'Unterdruckquelle' (vacuum source).

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 0020) The reference mentions optical and/or acoustic error messages, which could be a warning indicator, but does not specify its placement on a rigid body for visibility during lifting.
features.quote_src: es wird über eine optische und/oder akustische Schnittstelle eine Fehlermeldung ausgegeben

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper system but does not specify a single-hand portable design or that all components are carried by a rigid body without external connections.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a comprehensive monitoring system using an integrated pressure sensor, which is highly relevant to the subject invention's core features of vacuum sensing and warning. However, it lacks specific details about a cordless, handheld, battery-powered design.
